I bought the 17.2l urn to use as a mash tun for making small batches of craft beer and it works absolutely perfectly. The build quality is superb and if I had to replace it in the future ( which is very unlikely) I would buy the same again.
keeps it cold. easy to clean. probably better for hot liquids.

Although not yet assembled yet, I have unpacked the box and am very happy with the contents and especially the detailed construction booklet. I am most impressed with the order to delivery time which was just two days. Excellent service, thank you. One small complaint, far to many emails confirming order etc.

Nice trailer —. There was a problem with the PTO arms on the tractor hitting the trailer and the trailer stem had to be extended. I lined the box interior with plywood and painted it up ( satin black). It looks great and works even better.
Good price, sturdier than I expected for that price. Instructions could be clearer, had to remove/remount 6 bolts because the drawings were unclear. Satisfied, follows the ride-on mower perfectly

Bought this for 17 year Daschund. He couldn't make the hope up the deck steps anymore. I think the ramp is built very sturdy. The carpet pad makes it easy for grip. Like the safety clamp on top to ensure it doesnt slip down. My only addition to this product would be sides. I screwed plywood to the side so the boy would not fall off while walking up. Took 5 mons to put on. Other than that very good ramp.
On dirait des vrais a voir dans le temps mais très satisfaite pour le moment

Gekocht eind augustus en viel alles bij elkaar toch wat tegen. Had wat vollere boompjes verwacht maar oogden qua formaat "magertjes". Sommige takjes vallen er bij het in elkaar zetten redelijk snel uit.
Not the same wow factor as the other trees I purchasedVevor offer me full refund and no hassle. I would recommend Vevor to everyone.
Muito bom para carregar minha máquina de lavar louças que pesa 46kg, subi facilmente 3 andares de escada. Recomendo paciência e resistência!
Génial pour les escaliers; En plus moi qui suis nulle pour assembler quoi que soit, je suis arrivée facilement à monter les roues ( les petite)

The cart works well with a slight modification I made to bring my wifes electric wheelchair up and down the stairs. It make it much easier moving the chair up and down the stairs. I'm 75 and not as strong as I once was.

Quality is excellent; it feels sturdy and durable. Using the cart is a breeze; its design makes navigating stairs and uneven surfaces effortless. However, my only minor issue is that friends and family keep borrowing it! It seems to have become the go-to solution for everyone. Overall, I highly recommend this hand cart.

We love this cart! It's light weight and carries a 260 lb. load. It works perfect for moving things up and down stairs. Have used it to move window unit air conditioners, bricks and cement blocks. This thing is one of the handiest tools in my garage and for the price you can't go wrong.
GGreat item, very reliable price, excellent. Load capacity as they advertise great dolly going up the stairs.
